Validation results for the ad-tone model

ad_tone_validation.Rd

A textscale_validation object produced by validate_model() for the ad-tone example. Contains test-set accuracy and calibration metrics for the textscale model fit to the Carlson & Montgomery (2017) Wisconsin ads using the human pairwise annotations in cm_comparisons.

Usage

ad_tone_validation

Format

A textscale_validation object (a list) with three elements:

metrics

A one-row tibble with columns n_pairs, n_correct, accuracy, and ici.

cal_df

A data frame with columns prob (predicted probability) and result (observed outcome) for each test comparison. Used to construct the calibration plot.

ici

Integrated Calibration Index (scalar).

See also

validate_model(), ad_tone, cm_comparisons
